blockers.remaining: Prove effective interop/automount denial and alternate-path/inherited-descriptor behavior in a separately authorized fixed test. No claim of proven exploit or isolation.
Exact virtual-account rights, loss/protected/lifetime coverage and host/guest CPU ownership/deduplication are unproven. No privilege fallback or complete-coverage override.
Resolve exact operator/service identities and access masks, service/client peer authentication, independently pinned public key and full pre-enrollment guest bootstrap protocol.

Pin image/source/build/entire installed runtime tree and actual new binary/glibc hashes; proposed distribution/path collisions must be checked before creation. Current private digest is historical, not a new-build pin.

Actual polkit/delegation policy unknown; fixed privileged broker unimplemented. Exact memory headroom, CPU/capacity/accounting values and future official adapter require review; current query-process limits prove none of these.
blockers.topic: Guest policy/unit limits and controlled launcher

blockers.remaining: Protected anchor publication/rollback handling and independent control path are unimplemented; specify WSL suspension/restart/supervisor-death semantics without implying a real-time guarantee. Bound journal/log growth for the longest window and establish fresh C: state-store space/parent ACLs; no current capacity or durability claim.
No accepted WSL metadata/container/launcher replacement, host verdict, operator window, worker-tier drill or pre-freeze review. This design does not request OD-R2-0(D).
